//: Colocated `*.test.ts` files are part of this project rather than excluded from it. They have to belong to some project or they are neither type-checked by `tsc --build` nor lintable — ESLint's project service resolves a file through the nearest tsconfig.json, so a test the config excludes is a parsing error. The cost is compiled tests in `dist`, which is inert: this package is private, and `exports` only reaches `dist/index.js`.
